description:
THREE IDENTITIES IN ONE PAINTING.
Keep Spell I, Spell II, and Spell III as distinct identities — each stays itself (subject, form, palette). They share one scene and interact. Not a triptych, not a 3-panel collage, not one mashed hybrid that erases any identity.
Studio author: Logan Sevin.

MANDATORY PRODUCT PALETTE (override all source colors): Yellow (#FACC15); Orange (#F97316); Green (#16A34A). Paint with these hex pigments as dominant hues.

THE THREE IDENTITIES (keep each one recognizable):
SPELL I — Vibrant Mediterranean Courtyard (#957)
Vibrant Mediterranean Courtyard

A sunlit alleyway between warm yellow and orange buildings features stone steps, potted flowers, and hanging plants. The scene is bathed in bright daylight with colorful shadows on the cobblestone ground.

Style: Impr
